the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Let a detailed reply be filed.
We have made it clear that the notice was issued in this matter only on the quantum of the sentence.

In as much as considering that it is a case of Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code as well as Sections 5 & 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act read with the provisions of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, the petitioner was awarded life imprisonment.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner would only argue that the provisions of the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act are not made out in the present case.
Argument in this case, shall be made therefore only as to the applicability of the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.

(NIRMALA NEGI) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR)
